title: CNF formula cost
statement: For a CNF formula $\varphi$ over a type $\alpha$, define its cost to be the sum, over all clauses $C$ in the formula, of $|C|+1$, where $|C|$ is the clause length.
hypotheses_covered: A CNF formula over a type $\alpha$
